notes: 15 units over 15 source ids and all 22 target ids.

*most* on s014 is the only judgement call. Keeping it inside the substantive's unit is supported by rule 31: מְרִי is a substantive rendered by a multi-word English phrase, so the supplied word joins the unit and the head stays on *rebellious*, whose loss would lose the lexeme. The `added` alternative is named in the unit note per rule 8.
The copula *are* sits on the predicate under rule 20, leaving s015 הֵמָּה only its own *they*; the object marker s003 is unrepresented because the ASV writes *my words* bare (rule 16).
